travelers.name: Jennie
travelers.note: AA 136 overnight LAX to Heathrow Jun 8, lands 11:05 AM Jun 9

trip.summary: A nonstop to Lisbon opens the Iberian leg, then the Alfa Pendular up to Porto for three nights, a short flight to Madrid, the AVE to Barcelona, and three nights in Seville. A nonstop from Seville to London on Jun 8, Avanti to Manchester for back-to-back Oasis shows at the Etihad (Fri Jun 11 and Sat Jun 12), then a 3-night London encore before flying home Jun 16.
trip.disclaimer: Fares and rates are researched estimates as of October 2026 for May-June 2027 travel and will vary with booking date and availability. US citizens need no visa for stays under 90 days; the EU's ETIAS authorization (about 7 EUR online) is expected to be required by 2027 - confirm before departure. Travel insurance with medical coverage recommended.

guides.title: Where to eat: francesinha
guides.tip: Ordering, anywhere: com ovo (fried egg on top), fries for the sauce, and a fino (a small draft beer) is the local pairing.

spots.name: Cervejaria Brasão (Aliados)
spots.query: Cervejaria Brasão Aliados Rua de Ramalho Ortigão 28 Porto
spots.note: My pick if you only have one. Modern benchmark overlooking the Aliados area: francesinha is the house star, sauce rich but balanced, premium ingredients, and half portions available. A sandwich-by-sandwich comparison picked it as the city's best overall, ahead of Santiago. Bookable, sit-down, comfortable.

spots.name: Café Santiago
spots.query: Café Santiago Rua de Passos Manuel 226 Porto
spots.note: The famous classic. Serving francesinhas for more than 50 years, and its special sauce is rated by many as one of the best in town. No-frills and busy: expect a queue, no reservations.

spots.name: Bufete Fase
spots.query: Bufete Fase Rua de Santa Catarina 1147 Porto
spots.note: The locals' no-nonsense pick. Since 1984, cooked in front of you, only the typical francesinha (no modern variations, no spicy version; add your own). Smoother, milder sauce. Arrive early; it's up Santa Catarina, north of centre.

spots.name: A Regaleira
spots.query: A Regaleira Rua do Bonjardim 87 Porto
spots.note: The original. Daniel David de Silva created the francesinha here in 1953, adapting the croque monsieur with local meats and a custom beer-and-tomato sauce. Spicier sauce with a cumin kick. Go for the history.

spots.name: O Afonso
spots.query: O Afonso Rua da Torrinha 219 Porto
spots.note: The dark horse, decorated as a shrine to Ayrton Senna. Per Taste Porto's local guide, "to many, this is the best francesinha in town"; Bourdain was pointed here.

guides.title: Where to eat: bars with free tapas
guides.intro: Eleven bars where a drink comes with a free tapa, in the article's order. How much you get and how good it is varies from bar to bar.

source.name: Madrid Secreto, "11 bars in Madrid where the beers come with free tapas" (April 2025)

spots.name: Bar la Amistad
spots.address: Paseo de Santa María de la Cabeza 53 (Arganzuela)
spots.query: Bar la Amistad Paseo de Santa María de la Cabeza 53 Madrid
spots.note: Neighborhood bar with a big terrace; you pick your tapas from the display case. The article puts several tapas plus a beer at about 7 euros. No QR codes or reservations.

spots.name: El Tigre Sidra Bar and El Tigre del Norte
spots.address: Calle de las Infantas 23 and 30, Calle de Hortaleza 23 (Chueca)
spots.query: El Tigre Calle de las Infantas 30 Madrid
spots.note: Lively bar the article recommends for first-timers. It gives no details on the tapas or prices.

spots.name: El Lagar
spots.query: El Lagar Restaurante Calle de Ferraz 39 Madrid
spots.note: Traditional, unfussy bar popular with students. Word of mouth says the tapa gets better the more you order.

spots.name: El Respiro
spots.query: El Respiro Calle de las Infantas 34 Madrid
spots.note: Tavern run by Galicians. Tapas range from scrambled eggs with asparagus to braviolis.

spots.name: La Pomarada
spots.query: La Pomarada Calle del Conde Duque 3 Madrid
spots.note: Traditional Asturian cachopo place that kept its old look. Tapas change daily and sometimes come as pinchos. The article recommends the potato omelette and mentions a free cachopo buffet.

spots.name: Bar Sierra
spots.query: Bar Sierra Calle de Galileo 41 Madrid
spots.note: Small bar often full of students. A beer comes with tapas at the same price.

spots.name: La Pequeña Graná
spots.query: La Pequeña Graná Calle de Embajadores 124 Madrid
spots.note: An Embajadores street icon that follows the Andalusian free-tapa tradition.

spots.name: El Rincón Abulense
spots.address: Calle de Caballero de Gracia 18 (Gran Vía)
spots.query: El Rincón Abulense Calle de Caballero de Gracia 18 Madrid
spots.note: Homemade tapas and friendly, funny waiters. Next to Hotel Senator.

spots.name: Padrao Bar
spots.query: Padrao Bar Travesía de la Parada 4 Madrid
spots.note: Every drink comes with a free snack, such as a big sandwich, paella or wings, and you cannot choose which. The regular menu has huevos rotos, bravas and calamares.

spots.name: Casa Iván
spots.query: Casa Iván Plaza Virgen del Romero 8 Madrid
spots.note: Large terrace where each drink comes with an Asian-style tapa, such as uramaki, noodles, croquettes or wings.

spots.name: La Petisqueira (and La Petisqueira II)
spots.address: Calle de Churruca 6 and Calle de Mejía Lequerica 17 (Alonso Martínez)
spots.query: La Petisqueira Calle de Churruca 6 Madrid
spots.note: Very generous tapas, closer to a small portion. A double beer is 4.75 euros per the article. Often packed.

guides.title: Viewpoints (miradouros)
guides.intro: Ten viewpoints in the article's order. Several are within a short walk of each other in Alfama and Graca, so group them by neighborhood. The article gives no street addresses; the area shown is where each one sits.

source.name: Embrace Some Place, "Best Lisbon Viewpoints (Miradouros Worth Visiting)" (updated September 2026)

spots.name: Miradouro de Sao Pedro de Alcantara
spots.query: Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara, Lisbon
spots.note: Garden terrace the author likes at sunset. She says the Gloria funicular next to it is closed.

spots.name: Miradouro da Nossa Senhora do Monte
spots.query: Miradouro da Nossa Senhora do Monte, Lisbon
spots.note: The highest point in the city. A steep climb, which the article says is worth it for the view.

spots.name: Miradouro das Portas do Sol
spots.query: Miradouro das Portas do Sol, Lisbon
spots.note: The busiest viewpoint on the list, with musicians most evenings. Best at sunrise to avoid the crowd.

spots.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
spots.query: Miradouro de Santa Luzia, Lisbon
spots.note: Relaxed tiled terrace over the river and Alfama, about a three-minute walk from Portas do Sol.

spots.name: Miradouro da Graca (Sophia de Mello Breyner Andresen)
spots.query: Miradouro da Graça Sophia de Mello Breyner Andresen, Lisbon
spots.note: The author's pick for sunset, with the castle in view and a cafe on site.

spots.name: Terracos do Carmo
spots.query: Terraços do Carmo, Lisbon
spots.note: Rooftop terrace by the Carmo church ruins with much the same view as the Santa Justa lift.

spots.name: Castelo de Sao Jorge
spots.query: Castelo de São Jorge, Lisbon
spots.note: The walls give wide views, but the ticket (about 17 euros per the article) covers the whole castle, not just the view.

spots.name: Elevador de Santa Justa
spots.query: Elevador de Santa Justa, Lisbon
spots.note: The article does not recommend queuing to ride it and says it is closed in 2026; Terracos do Carmo has a similar view.

spots.name: Miradouro do Recolhimento
spots.address: Near the castle and Portas do Sol
spots.query: Miradouro do Recolhimento, Lisbon
spots.note: Quieter alternative with a similar view, reached by a path past a playground.

spots.name: Miradouro de Santa Catarina
spots.query: Miradouro de Santa Catarina, Lisbon
spots.note: Best for the street musicians and the atmosphere rather than the view itself.

days.plan: Depart LAX 4:30 PM (Terminal B) on TAP TP248; dinner and lie-flat sleep aboard.

days.title: Arrive Lisbon
days.plan: Arrive 11:30 AM. Metro or taxi to the hotel in Baixa. Stop at As Bifanas do Afonso (Rua da Madalena 146) for a bifana, the classic Lisbon pork sandwich. Gentle first evening: sunset at Miradouro de Santa Catarina, dinner nearby.

days.plan: 9:00 AM Lisbon Walking Tour with Belem Tower, Tram and Boat Cruise. Then warm pasteis de nata at the 1837 bakery; afternoon MAAT or the Coach Museum. Dinner at O Velho Eurico (Largo de São Cristóvão 3).

days.plan: Sao Bento station's azulejo hall, Livraria Lello and Clerigos Tower; lunch at Mercado do Bolhao; afternoon six-bridges Douro cruise. Evening option: an intimate fado show in a historical tavern (GetYourGuide; not booked, so check the date, time, price and location on the listing).

days.title: Fly to Madrid
days.plan: Morning nonstop from Porto to Madrid (1h15); metro or taxi to the hotel by Gran Via. Afternoon: Retiro Park and the Crystal Palace. Dinner at La Barquette - Meat Bar (Corredera Baja de San Pablo 10).

places.name: Dinner: La Barquette - Meat Bar
places.query: La Barquette - Meat Bar, Corredera Baja de San Pablo 10, 28004 Madrid, Spain

days.title: Madrid in a Day tour
days.plan: 10:00 AM Madrid in a Day tour: Prado Museum, Royal Palace and a historic city walk. Afternoon at the Thyssen-Bornemisza, if there is energy left.

days.title: Toledo and Segovia tour
days.plan: 8:30 AM Toledo and Segovia full-day tour from Madrid. Evening flamenco at Corral de la Moreria.

days.title: Open day in Madrid
days.plan: Open day: the Toledo trip moved to the May 31 tour. Ideas: Almudena Cathedral, or a slow afternoon in Retiro Park.

days.title: AVE to Barcelona
days.plan: Morning AVE to Barcelona (2h30, first class). Metro L3 to Passeig de Gracia; afternoon on the boulevard. Casa Batllo is four blocks from the Cotton House.

days.title: Girona and Costa Brava
days.plan: 8:30 AM Girona and Costa Brava day trip from Barcelona. Evening seafood in Barceloneta.

days.title: Sagrada Familia, Park Guell and the Gothic Quarter
days.plan: Your full Barcelona day. Sagrada Familia with early timed entry, then Park Guell. Late afternoon in the Gothic Quarter with a stop at La Boqueria market, then a sunset drink on the Cotton House's L'Atelier terrace. The Picasso Museum no longer fits; swap it for Park Guell if you prefer.

days.title: Fly to Seville
days.plan: Nonstop flight to Seville (~1h45); EA bus or taxi; the hotel faces the Cathedral. Evening paseo through Santa Cruz's lanes.

days.title: Cordoba day trip
days.plan: About 8:00 AM train Seville to Cordoba (40-45 min), then a taxi to the old town. 9:00-10:30 Mezquita-Catedral, inside the morning window. 11:00-12:15 Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos and its gardens, well before the early close. 12:30 Synagogue and a wander through the Jewish Quarter. Lunch (salmorejo is the local dish), then the Roman Bridge and free time. About 5:00-6:00 PM train back to Seville.

places.name: Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos
places.query: Alcázar de los Reyes Cristianos, Córdoba

days.title: Alcazar and flamenco
days.plan: Real Alcazar early with a private guide, then the Cathedral and (optional) Giralda climb, literally across the street from the hotel. Evening flamenco at a Triana tablao.

days.title: Fly to London
days.plan: Morning flight from Seville to London Gatwick (flight to be decided, ~2h50). Arrive early afternoon; train or taxi into the city to the hotel. Evening walk along the Thames near the hotel. Jennie departs LAX tonight.

days.title: Jennie arrives
days.plan: Morning: Westminster Abbey and the Churchill War Rooms, then Sky Garden (reminder: get tickets 3 weeks ahead, around May 19, 2027). Jennie lands at 11:05 AM and joins you at the hotel; celebratory West End theatre night, the three of you.

places.name: Sky Garden
places.query: Sky Garden, 20 Fenchurch Street, London EC3M 8AF

days.title: Train to Manchester
days.plan: 8:30 AM Express Tower of London tour with Crown Jewels access (about 1.5 hours guided, then free time in the White Tower and Jewel House; meet outside the Tower gift shop, a short walk from the Cheval Three Quays). Then a train from Euston after midday so there is time to collect bags (Avanti, 2h07); drop bags at the Kimpton Clocktower (check-in from 3 PM), a 10-minute walk from Piccadilly. Afternoon: Science and Industry Museum or a Man City stadium tour; dinner in Spinningfields.

days.title: OASIS - Night one
days.plan: OASIS AT THE ETIHAD, NIGHT ONE. Easy day in the Northern Quarter: record shops, cafes, Oasis's old stomping ground. Early dinner, then Metrolink to Etihad Campus.

days.title: OASIS - Night two
days.plan: OASIS AT THE ETIHAD, NIGHT TWO. Recover slowly; optional Liverpool half-day (~50 min by train, Beatles story at Albert Dock). Back for the Saturday show.

places.name: Beatles Story, Albert Dock
places.query: The Beatles Story, Albert Dock, Liverpool

days.title: Back to London
days.plan: Avanti back to Euston by midday. Proper Sunday roast; lazy afternoon at the National Gallery or along the South Bank.

days.title: Windsor or Greenwich
days.plan: Day trip: Windsor Castle (~1h), or Greenwich by riverboat. Evening: Devour historic pubs food tour in the City of London (about 3.5 hours, four tastings with drinks, from about $97 per person per the tour page; not booked, so check dates and times).

places.name: Devour pubs tour meeting point (St Andrew Holborn gardens)
places.query: The Gardens of St Andrew's Church Holborn, 5 St Andrew Street, London EC4A 3AF

days.title: London in a Day tour
days.plan: 9:30 AM London in a Day tour: Westminster Abbey, Big Ben and the Tower of London. Borough Market for a late lunch, then farewell dinner at Gillray's overlooking the Thames.

days.title: Fly home
days.plan: Relaxed morning and an early lunch, then the Heathrow Express from Paddington (or a pre-booked car) by about 1:30 PM for AA 135 at 4:25 PM. All three of you land at LAX at 7:35 PM the same evening.
